decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The roof lights proposed for the front elevation is considered unsatisfactory in the form shown on the drawings submitted to date and this aspect of the scheme should be modified to show one roof light and the positioning and size shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced to ensure an acceptable form of development.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of work.
description: Erection of roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
